description: Canonical strategy structure mode registry for strategy-rule display. Workflow types such as Parameter Matrix and WFA are intentionally separate from strategy mode.

engine_families.description: Shared execution engine for any backtest that can be compiled into checkpoints, target weights, fills, holdings, and risk events.

capability_layers.label: Factor pipeline
capability_layers.description: Retired because the implementation changed results in Python. Supported factor calculations must use computed_fields[] in the shared Rust engine; unsupported operations require a reviewed Rust building block.

strategy_profiles.description: Scan a broad stock pool, apply eligibility/selection rules, enter only symbols whose local trigger fires, exit by explicit sell rules, and enforce a max simultaneous holdings cap without creating a new engine family.
Rule-driven portfolio weight changes across assets without opening a separate strategy path.
Rank-and-pick rotation expressed through the shared portfolio engine.
Calendar or session-driven exposure changes compiled into the shared portfolio engine.
Two-leg spread or relative-value structure expressed through one shared portfolio engine, with explicit long/short target weights and timeline events instead of a separate engine family.
Multi-leg event-driven portfolio actions such as baskets, overlays, hedges, or staged exposure shifts compiled into the same shared action and accounting core.

strategy_presets.description: Authoring shortcut for one-asset or very small fixed-universe signal strategies. It compiles into the shared selection_timing_portfolio path instead of opening a separate engine family.

modes.label: Shared portfolio engine
modes.description: Any strategy that can be compiled into checkpoints, target weights, fills, holdings, and risk events runs through this one shared engine.

analysis_overlays.label: Pattern win-rate scanner
analysis_overlays.description: Pure diagnostic overlay for counting pattern hit-rate without trade, holding, capital, or portfolio equity simulation. Trading triggered assets belongs to selection_timing_portfolio on the shared engine.
